scope: Pre-solver clarification of the frozen model;no inputs, batch membership, thresholds or source counts changed
terminal_phase_scope: For each candidate8-row sector: finish all B filter chains, immediately perform that sector's original-order terminal pass, then discard all query state before the next sector. Never queue terminal masks across sectors.
terminal_membership: Conservatively verify every query-point whose rounded guarded depth is30, including nonhits that might be provable at the last zone. This is a declared protocol, not unavoidable verification work.
terminal_source: 960*32B for each sector having at least one terminal query-point;no filter-to-terminal tile reuse. Independent queries pay this per query-sector; shared schedules pay once per sector.
full_scan_control: One complete original-order batched scan with B independent distance accumulators;no second terminal scan. It has more query-coordinate arithmetic than pruning schedules.
oracle_initial_witness: Eager-serve-all normalization of PREFIX_TRIE is a feasible witness no longer than the original trie. Oracle UB takes the minimum of that witness and both greedy witnesses.
state_accounting: B*8 FP64 partial sums and B bytes of per-query candidate masks are live only within one sector. Query vectors and orders are separate resident inputs. Mask/partial load-store bandwidth, output and GPU residency remain unmeasured.
